interpretation: Run50 and Run51 both used the exact TU2 effective image and the pinned Release runtime host.

The object byte at +0xC and timeout arguments alone do not prove a host wait/import defect or guest queue defect.

Do not change synchronization, syscall, queue, or import behavior until the exact guest helper, queue-header layout, and import contract are traced and independently validated.
